text: Banco Santander, S.A. is Ebury's majority shareholder with a 55% stake, and remains so after the April 2026 funding rounds led by Centerbridge.
short: Banco Santander keeps a 55% majority stake in Ebury.

source.name: Ebury: Ebury, Santander's international payments fintech, secures c.£550 million to accelerate growth and global expansion (press release)
source.quote: Santander invest £50 million and remain Ebury's majority shareholder with a 55% stake
